description:
NOTE: App is no longer developed, source repo has been archived.
Features:
* add, edit and remove products
* save best-before date
* search through products
* data import and export
Supported languages:
* English
* Czech
* Danish
* Dutch
* Finnish
* French
* German
* Hungarian
* Polish
* Portuguese (BR)
* Spanish (AR)
* Turkish
* Ukrainian
Wiki:
You have questions, need help to set up the app or simply want to know more about it? Then take a look at the Wiki.
